note: An anchored additional physical delivery adds the documented column to the named version beside the native variable's other columns of that version, which keep their own states; it copies no documented type, and only an explicit storage header types it. The [[identity.partition]] maps give each column its owner (without them the native variable has several spellings and is withheld). Expected literals: the sibling states (OTHER and SECOND 2020, EARLIER 2018) and the added ADD 2020 state from preserves_siblings (column names VALUE/OTHER/SECOND/EARLIER kept; addition column VALUE); ADD 2020 data_type null from preserves_siblings and storage_header[None] (data_type None); ADDP 2020 text from storage_header[PHYSICAL] (CIS2020 PHYSICAL varchar -> text). The drift halves of preserves_siblings replay a stored case and have no build form.
fails_if: `scb_errata.convert_delivered_entry` rewrites the target version's sibling rows to the added column (drops the `matching and additional_physical_column` branch), copies the donor's documented type into the addition, or looks storage up by the entry column instead of `storage_column`
